description: Previous Quest: [Ratcatcher](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=444331) Next Quest: [First Steps](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=444314) Reward(s): - Stone Pickaxe - x10 Astral Rune - x10 Air Rune - Tome of Woodcutting Quest Steps: - Speak to Zanik, near the river down the road from the temple - Bring 50 ash logs to Zanik - Mine Rune Essence, build a Rune Altar and craft some Air Runes and some Astral Runes - Return to Zanik - Completing this will start the next part of [First Steps](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=444314)

title: Dragon Slayer
description: Previous Quest: [First Steps](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=444314) Next Quest: [Withering Heights](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=507878) Reward(s): - Tome of the Dragon Slayer - Anti-Dragon Shield - Dragon Visage - [Masterwork Recipe: Dragonblight Shield](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=445926) Quest Steps: - Construct a base of operations in Bramblemead village. Build a shelter and claim a bed. - Speak to the Wise Old Man in Bramblemead village - Hunt a deer and bring one of its antlers to the Wise Old Man - Siege the goblin castle and look for Cathan - [Cathan's Journal [Castle]](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=444632) - Investigate the blue-flame door in the swamp. Find out what Cathan is up to - Speak with Spitfoot in the lever room inside the [Dragonkin Vault](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=444651) - Speak to the Wise Old Man in the Bramblemead village - Gear yourself up and push forward into Ghornfell in search of Cathan - Investigate Velgar's tower in search of Cathan - Speak with Cathan's ghost in front of the tower - Find the ingredients and craft the Challenge Horn. Check the recipe in your journal for more information - You'll need to gather Bloodwood Sap at the [Bloodwood Tree](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=445273), which will require an iron axe. - You'll need to gather Dragon's Tooth at the [Dragon's Skull](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=445455), which will require an iron pickaxe. - Summon and defeat Velgar - Bring Velgar's head to the Wise Old Man in Bramblemead village

description: Previous Quest: [Dragon Slayer](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=444425) Next Quest: [Black Knight Fortress](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=555255) Rewards: - [Masterwork Recipe: Dragoncurse Shield](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=508737) - Tome of the Undying - Dragoncurse Shield - Undead Draconic Visage Quest Steps: - Speak to the Wise Old Man near Ashien's Watch. - Unlock the strange door. - Speak to the [temple's inhabitant](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=507881). - Speak with [Postie Pete](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=507884). - Enter the Shattered Spire and defeat Imaru. - Bring Imaru's head to Death.

title: Icthlarin's Little Helper
description: Previous Quest: [Black Knight Fortress](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=555255) Next Quest: [Regicide](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=955243) Rewards: - Dragonfire Shield - Tome of Volcano - Cabbage Quest Steps: - Enter the Umbral Sands - Look for signs of life in the desert - Speak to Icthlarin at the Mirror Relay - Speak to the Alcarrid Elder and complete tasks to earn their trust - Gain the trust of the Alcarrid Camp - [The Mirror Crack'd](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=608412) - [Rogue Trader](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=608415) - [Rag and Bone Garou](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=608431) - You have completed the tribe's tasks. Return to the Alcarrid Elder - Travel to Moon Garou camps, find their elders, and earn their trust to gain their Mirror Lenses - [Gaimbin - Uzzer Elder](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=608447) - [Saga of the Adventurer](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=608449) - [The Dig Site](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=611041) - [Mark Day](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=611058) - [Dushlanach - Manafem Elder](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=611061) - [Song of the Ancients](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=611063) - [Scaling Difficulties](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=611066) - [Beast in the Sand](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=611075) - Complete tasks for the final camp and gain their Mirror Lens - Speak to Icthlarin at the Mirror Relay - Place the three Mirror Lenses into the Mirror Relay - Enter the Fight Caves and defeat Fuzan - [Fuzan](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=611078) - Bring Fuzan's head to Icthlarin at the Mirror Relay

title: Regicide
description: Previous Quest: [Icthlarin's Little Helper](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=608407) Rewards: - Dragonslayer's Cape - Dragon Kiteshield - Dragon Full Helm Quest Steps: - Gain access to the Scorned Wilderness. - Speak to Zilyana. - [Commander Zilyana](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=955255) - Once you are fully prepared, speak to Zilyana. - Defeat Kuldra. - [Kuldra](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=955307) - Bring Kuldra's head to Zilyana.

title: Restless Ghosts
description: How to start: Interact with the well inside the village Reward(s): - Tome of Mining - Tome of Cooking - Tome of Woodcutting - Tome of the Artisan Quest Steps: - Search for a purpose for the Amulet of Ghostspeak. - Find the restless spirits and help lay them to rest. They only appear at night. - You'll need to find and speak with each of the spirits: - [Warren's Spirit](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=444363) - [Lazina's Spirit](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=445195) - [Finn's Spirit](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=445260) - [Kay's Spirit](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=445261) - Then, head to the remembrance shrine in the graveyard next to the temple in the beginning of the game and remember the fallen explorers.

title: Warding Off Danger
description: How to start: Craft a piece of magic armor Reward(s): - x2 Small Wardstones Quest Steps: - Speak to the Wise Old Man to learn about Lifewards. - Craft a Wardstone at a Rune Altar and bring it to the Wise Old Man. - Bring your Wardstone to the Wise Old Man.

title: Highlighting the Problem
description: How to start: Interact with the statue in the courtyard Reward(s): - Masterwork Recipe: Staff of Light Quest Steps: - Investigate the area for clues about the statue - Investigate the hidden area inside the [Dragonkin Vault](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=444560) with the broken bridge. Requires the spell Windstep to get up to the ledge - Search the Runecrafting Guild for a statue - Find a way to charge the mysterious orb

title: Goblin Diplomacy
description: How to start: Interact with the reliquary behind the [Thorny Vine](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=444996) inside the ruins (Requires at least 20 logging to destroy the thorny vines) Reward(s): - Goblin War Banner Cape Quest Steps: - Find someone that can identify the Bandosian amulet. - Investigate the ruin northeast of Zanik. - Interact with the reliquary in the small room of the ruins behind some barrels - Search for the other amulet piece in an area filled with mud and stagnant swampwater. - Head into the cave in the Whispering Swamp where a [Chest](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=445450) is located and defeat the Goblin Shaman there. - Bring both amulets to Zanik.

title: Dog Days
description: How to start: Speak to Vannaka in his small camp under a rock overhang Reward(s): - Garou Highborn's Cloak Quest Steps: - Search Garou camps beneath giant wyrm bones in the Highlands for information on Garou ritual practices - Read the lore scrap [Ritual of Purification](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=445453) in the Garou camp to the west - Challenge a Garou king in their Highland stronghold and claim their token - The stronghold is the large structure in the north-west portion of the Highlands - Complete the ritual of purification on the King's Token at the ancient shrine where "a heart once beat" - Head over to [Lougrim's Shrine](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=445461) at Wyrm's heart and complete the ritual, requiring three Shocking Plant Bulbs and two Ram Horns - Bring the Purified King's Token to Vannaka in the Ghornfell Highlands

title: Granite Mauled
description: How to start: Speak with Doric next to some ruins on top of a plateau Reward(s): - Imbued Granite Maul Head - [Masterwork Recipe: Granite Maul](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=445927) - [Recipe: Imbued Granite Maul Head](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=445929) - [Recipe: Imbued Leather Wrappings](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=445930) - [Recipe: Ornate Maul Handle](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=445931) Quest Steps: - Investigate the secrets hidden below Ashien's Watch. - To enter the vault at Ashien's Watch, you'll need to activate four statues around the area: - [Dragonkin Statue](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=445445) - [Dragonkin Statue](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=445446) - [Dragonkin Statue](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=445447) - [Dragonkin Statue](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=445448) - After activating all four statues, head into the [Dragonkin Vault](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=445449), progress through it, defeat the bosses at the end, and interact with the statue. - Bring the blueprint to Doric in Ashien's Watch.

title: Growing Pains
description: How to start: Level up your farming skill Reward(s): - x3 Plant Cure - Tome of Farming - Vol 2 Quest Steps: - Speak to the Wise Old Man in Bramblemead to learn about the Farming skill. - Grow and harvest your first crop from a farming plot. - Return to the Wise Old Man in Bramblemead.

title: Even More Restless Ghosts
description: How to start: Speak with [Zanik](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=507925) after acquiring the Ghostspeak Amulet Reward(s): - [Recipe: Dorgeshuun Crossbow](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=508887) Quest Steps: - Find ghosts and complete their unfinished business. - Build a house around the [Windswept Ghost](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=508826) - Give a Clay Decoration to the [Reminiscing Ghost](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=508855) - Return the [Sketchbook](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=508885) to the [Paint-Spattered Ghost](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=508859) - Return to Zanik.

title: The Wild Hunt
description: How to start: Speak with [Vannaka](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=508784) in his camp Reward(s): - Unlocks Mounts Quest Steps: - Hunt down [Nature Spirits](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?search=nature_spirit) near Fellhollow's willow groves and bring three of their hearts to Vannaka. - Bring the Primordial Heart to someone with an interest in the wild hunt.

title: Seeking Salvation
description: How to start: Speak with [Doric](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=508844) in his camp in front of [Skekven Kara](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=508670) Reward(s): - Salve Crystal Quest Steps: - Access the vault and find the hidden secret within. - To enter Skekven Kara, you'll need to activate four statues around the area: - [Dragonkin Statue](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=508849) - [Dragonkin Statue](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=508852) - [Dragonkin Statue](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=508893) - [Dragonkin Statue](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=508903) - After activating all four statues, head into Skekven Kara and head through the passage high up on the vault wall in the first large vault room and interact with the statue up there next to [Lacrussa's Writings](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=509097). - Bring the dwarven writing to Doric.

title: Things that go Boom in the Night
description: How to start: Speak with [Vannaka](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=508784) after completing [The Wild Hunt](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=508793) Reward(s): - Spectral Chinchompa Cape Quest Steps: - Gather 10 spectral chinchompa skulls and bring them to Vannaka in Fellhollow.

title: Doric's Quest
description: How to start: Speak with [Doric](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=508844) after completing [Seeking Salvation](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=508846) Reward(s): - [Recipe: Zombie Axe](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=525753) Quest Steps: - Craft an Undead Ranger's Bow and bring it to Doric in Fellhollow. Doric believes the recipe is in a vault somewhere. - Given by a Dragonkin Effigy inside [Skekven Kara](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=508670) - Craft a Necromancer's Staff and bring it to Doric in Fellhollow. Doric believes the recipe is in a vault somewhere. - Given by a Dragonkin Effigy inside [Vekchenven Kara](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=507895) - Craft a Shadow Sword and bring it to Doric in Fellhollow. Doric believes the recipe is in a vault somewhere. - Chance to drop from a Zogre

title: Wanted!
description: How to start: Speak with [Vannaka](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=555613) in his camp Reward(s): - [Recipe: Unholy Symbol](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=555618) Quest Steps: - Journal Pages Collected - [Rat Master's Journal](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=555442) - [Summoner's Journal](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=555586) - [Houndmaster's Journal](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=555617) - Return to Vannaka

title: Biohazard
description: How to start: Speak with [Zanik](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=555620) in the cell Reward(s): - Zamorak Cape Quest Steps: - Gather 10 biological samples from strange ravens in Dowdun Reach, and bring them to Zanik. - Bring Zanik the ingredients: [Dragon Blood](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?search=dragon+category:12752), a [Twilight Lily](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=555938) and some [Unholy Water](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=555952). - Find[ the source of the cthonian infection](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=555961), somewhere high up in Dowdun Reach. - Return to Zanik and explain the situation.

title: What's Theirs is Mine
description: How to start: Given by [Doric](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=555390) after progressing through [Black Knight Fortress](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=555255) Reward(s): - [Masterwork Recipe: Zamorak Staff](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=555637) Quest Steps: - Look for [signs of the mugger-mage](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=555630) in the Cathedral in Dowdun Keep. - Speak to Doric in the Dowdun Reach nexus. - Look for [signs of the mugger mage](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=555634) in the Garrisons of Dowdun Keep. - Speak to Doric in the Dowdun Reach nexus. - Look for [signs of the mugger mage](https://mapgenie.io/runescape-dragonwilds/maps/ashenfall?locationIds=555636) in the underground Demon Gate of Dowdun Keep. - Speak to Doric in the Dowdun Reach nexus.

title: Letters for the Dead
